It still fits bake-to-order: people order by the 6 pm cutoff the day before. When they collect, hand them a card that puts what they paid toward a subscription if they sign up within 2 weeks. **3. Building and workplace drops.** Find 2–3 apartment buildings or offices within 3 km and sign up a group at one address. Five or more boxes to one stop uses far less of the cargo bike's Saturday capacity than five separate homes. Ask a building manager, office manager or tenants' group to promote it for you. Their reward could be one free box for them, not a discount for everyone. This also works well with bake-to-order, because a group gives you a predictable batch.
